comparison.objective: Use an undercut T-slot rake to pull five chips from three channels into a collection bay.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a wide-foot rake through channel ends, navigate beneath ledges, and sweep multiple pieces.
comparison.success_condition: All five chips collected and rake returned to supports; numeric containment thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Both involve collecting small pieces, but this task’s central ability is undercut-channel raking; it lacks fracture creation, coaxial stabilization, and impact regulation.
